sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 2 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived on site and debriefing with night shift.
Welfare check Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience store. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
All clear, no issues. Standing by for presence.
Library area and Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards Skycity.
Arrived corner Federal and Victoria Street, welfare checks on both 77 Convenience stores, Coffee Club and Eighty Fed. Standby.
Wellesley Street all clear. Heading through Elliot Street.
Elliot and Darby Street all clear, all businesses no issues. Heading towards High Street.
High Street and Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading towards O'Connell Street.
O'Connell Street and Freyberg Square all clear. Heading to Chancery Square.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for presence.
Shortland Convenience store all clear. Continuing patrol.
Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Fort Street, Jo&Joe's, Imperial Lane and Wilson Carpark all clear. Heading towards Gore Street.
Welfare checks on Auckland Harbour Suites, Chargrill and whole of Gore Street completed. Standby for presence.
Coffee Club, Custom Mart, and 77 Convenience store Custom Street all clear. Heading to Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Checking Commercial Bay area.
Commercial Bay and TK Square all clear. Standby for presence.
Heading to check lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Metro Woolworths all clear. Heading up Albert Street.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing patrol.
Arrived corner Wyndham and Albert Street. Heading to check businesses and Cathedral area.
Shakespeare Tavern, Good to Go Supermarket and Cathedral area all clear. Standby for presence.
Arrived corner Victoria and Federal Street.
Welfare checks on all businesses, 77 Convenience stores, Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, News Agency store, all clear. Standby for presence.
Victoria Street Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse all clear. Standby for presence.
Heading to corner Queen and Victoria Street.
Starbucks, Puffing Kiwi and Sail City Mart all clear. Heading through Lorne Street towards Wellesley Street.
Lorne Street all clear. Heading to Queen Street.
Heading towards Darby Street while conducting welfare checks.
Yoyoso till Footlocker all clear. Heading to check Elliot Street.
Darby Street (Celine, Lumi Cafe, Recycle Boutique) all clear. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived and spoke to a tourist who asked for our job description. Standby for presence.
Heading down Queen Street and commencing welfare checks.
Welfare checks completed from Yoyoso till Specsavers. Worker from Thursday shift wanted an update on the Desiree theft; updated him and back on patrol.
Welfare checks on businesses from OPSM till JB Hi-Fi, then Kathmandu and Chemist Warehouse. Standing by at Chemist Warehouse as their security is on break.
Received a call from Security for Woolworths regarding a vagrant sleeping in front of their entrance. Heading over now.
Vagrant unresponsive due to being under the influence of narcotics.

The vagrant's name is Anthony Paki; he had on his person a small bag containing synthetic substances (Class C narcotics per the Police Sergeant). The vagrant is in breach of his bail being in possession of the substance. Heading to the call-out.
Male vagrant had vacated before we arrived. Heading to office for break.
Still no access to our building. Standing by for presence and updating reports.

Female concerned citizen informed us of a young female in need of assistance with housing or financial support. Informed the closest Auckland Council wardens; a team on their side is being dispatched.
Accessed HQ. Standing by upstairs for shift changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Heading back to HQ to let up Arvo guard to gear up.
Leaving HQ to commence patrols in upper Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks in upper Queen Street:
Area clear, no issues. Commencing Alpha route.
Commencing welfare checks in lower Queen Street.
Standing by at Imperial Lane to scope out the area and show presence. Area relatively busy.
Area busy but no issues. Continuing down Queen Street to Britomart.
T4 square all clear. Standing by at McDonald's; a couple of minors and vagrants in the area.
T4 Square all clear. Vagrants still in the area; will keep close by awaiting possible response calls.
Arrived New World, standing by to show presence.
New World area all clear, no calls to respond to. Continuing up Queen Street.
Arrived Vulcan Lane, scanning the area.
Vulcan Lane all clear, businesses no issues. Moving on.
Arrived corner Queen & Durham Street, standing by awaiting response calls.
All clear, only a handful of vagrants in the area. No issues.
Arrived Victoria Street East. Heading up towards High Street & Lorne Street for a sweep.
Arrived Freyberg Square. Spotted a group of minors hanging around. Heading down towards Shortland Street.
Area all clear. Night clubs opening soon so will sweep Fort Street before heading back up Queen Street.
Arrived Fort Street, Fort Lane all clear. Cutting through Commerce Street to Customs Street East.
Welfare check Jo&Joes, all clear. Moving on.
Back at Britomart & Queen Street. Heading back to upper Queen Street.
Received a call from Liquor Land on Victoria Street regarding a theft; male a possible re-offender. 25 minutes since the male left; staff to send a photo. Will keep a lookout during patrols.

Arrived Liquor Land Victoria Street. Staff explained the male walked in, grabbed a box of KGBz and walked straight out. Cost of item $47. Staff still acquiring a photo; members okay, just wanted to let us know.
Arrived top of Elliot Street, cutting through towards Wellesley Street West.
Elliot Stables all clear. Heading down Wellesley Street West to the Civic.
Arrived The Civic, standing by briefly before heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed, no issues. Heading back outside to standby.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues.
Received a call back from staff at Liquor Land Victoria Street; photos sent for Auror report. Logging on file.
File sent and reports all updated. Having break.
Received a call from Vulcan Lane regarding a male vagrant spitting on people.

Reports from members of the public and Michael state the POI was spitting on people including the wife of one of the customers. Heading out to look for the POI. Description: camouflage jacket, beanie, male caucasian.
Spoke to the POI, who was aggressive then became calm after we reasoned with him.
Spoke to Police at Vulcan Lane and gave our report; also updated Michael. Event number P066971198. Assisting with relocating the POI for Police.
Arrived the Library, no sign of the POI. Heading to office to do handover.
Handover completed. 2nd guard arrived and taking over shift.
2nd guard fully suited ready for shift. Charging ops phone (3%).
Letting standby guard up. On call for cover.
Letting another standby guard up. On call for cover.
Back-up guards in level 1 awaiting call in; expecting more standby guards. Awaiting response calls.
Received a call from Nix ops manager regarding another standby guard. Heading down to let up guard.
Received a call from Nikki ops manager to let him up to level 7.
Received another call from Nikki ops manager regarding another standby guard out front. Heading down to escort him up to level 1.
At HQ with night guard, awaiting 2nd night shift guard to arrive.
2nd Arvo shift guard clocking off; 1930 start guard taking over for night shift team to deploy at 2200. Still awaiting standby guards & HOTC night guard.
Equipment handover: 1 x swipe, 5 x Keys (including master key), 1 x vest (second guard wearing the other), 1 x ops phone. Arvo shift concluded, no further issues.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment handover: 2 x Vest, 1 x Bodycam, 1 x Radio, Op Phone, Keycard, keys.
Keeping presence within Queen Street and waiting on response calls. Standby to recharge the ops phone.
Response call from 3rd guard starting soon, in need of being tagged upstairs.
Arrived back at HQ, team now preparing to suit up for shift.
Response call from Management, need to escort a guard down to Take10 due to no guard present.
Arrived Take10 stand. Standby for presence before continuing patrols.
Welfare check at Reign n Pour, chatted with static guards, no issues reported.
Welfare check Club Kong and McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Standby.
Response call from Bar 101 Head Doorman reporting a male individual inside, reported by a female, seen with a knife stashed inside his jersey.

Arrived Bar 101. Description of the POI (5'7 male, white, medium build, beige quarter-zip jacket from Rodd & Gunn, black baggy denim jeans, white shoes, curly brown hair). Building sweep upstairs and crowd control commenced scoping for the individual; unsuccessful.
Police arrived shortly after and also did a building sweep for the individual, unsuccessful; POI possibly already left. Continuing patrols up Queen Street.
Response call from Management regarding the keycard for the office.
Keycard for HQ building retrieved from management. Continuing patrols up Queen Street.
Welfare check McDonald's, Cue City and Mid City, all clear.
Arrived check in Aotea Square, full walkthrough completed. Standby for response calls.
No issues during standby. Patrolling down Queen Street; heavy presence of semi-intoxicated individuals but well behaved, no issues.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, no issues. Scoped out the location, no problems.
Welfare check Reign and Pour, closing up now.
Welfare check Provedor, all clear. Heavy presence of customers lining up outside. Making way back to Britomart.
Arrived TK Square, standby to ensure presence.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed.
Arrived check in bottom of Fort Street, welfare check Mermaid and Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear. Patrolling back to HQ (low battery).
Welfare check along High Street, no issues.
Arrived check in Chancery Square, Freyberg Place, no issues.
Response call from Management at Bar 101 regarding a brawl beginning to break out, requesting immediate assistance.
Response call from Security Guard at Bar 101 reporting a fight breaking out.
Call back from the Security Guard, updating that the brawl was prevented and assistance no longer needed.
Arrived Bar 101. Standby for presence and waiting on further possible escalation.
Arrived HQ, standby to recharge the ops phone (low battery).
No response calls or incidents during standby. Clubs now closed; priorities moving forward on 24/7 convenience stores and McDonald's. 1 guard clocking off while two remain patrolling.
Standby at Elliot Street waiting for crowd to clear out.
Elliot Street and Darby Street all clear. Heading back to HQ for 30 minute break.
Check in Durham Street, all clear.
Check in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Check in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Full sweep Chancery Square / Freyberg, all clear.
Check in corner Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear. Heading back to HQ for changeover.
